messages:
Ravi: Observed weird artifact when we fail from hosted -> private: late tokens arrive without prefix context so assistant repeats intro. Repro attached.
Elena: Thanks — saw that too in staging. Looks like we sometimes send the first chunk before snapshot apply completes on target.
Marco: Current adapter flow: route decision -> send request to target runtime -> if fallback we concurrently push snapshot then stream. Race if snapshot apply > first-chunk latency.
Tess: Two concrete options: (A) stall the first chunk until snapshot apply ack (simpler semantics, adds failover latency), or (B) allow streaming and mark stream as "degraded" so client can drop/retry.
Ravi: Also thought of (C) split client-visible chunks into preface + body, where preface waits for restore and body streams. That preserves perceived UX while avoiding whole-stream stall.
Elena: Preface pattern is nice but requires SDK support to handle split messages. Not all clients will update.
Marco: Maybe make behavior pluggable per-route: low-latency interactive routes default to preface stall=false but add degrade header; long-running generation default stall=true. 
Tess: Need capability discovery on runtimes to know restore p95. Suggest runtime advertises {restore_p95_ms, supports_atomic_apply}. Control plane can pick stall threshold.
Ravi: Security note: snapshot apply must validate tenant nonce and be envelope-decrypted in runtime. If we stall, ensure we do not block other tenants' requests.
InfraBot: Deploy note: hosted-fallbacks v4 canary active (5 hosts).
Marco: Metrics to add: fallback_reorders, fallback_stream_degraded, fallback_restore_block_ms. Add tag: route.
Elena: I'll draft an RFC addendum with the 3 options, UX implications, and a small compatibility table.
Tess: For rollout: phase 0 emit degrade header + metrics; phase 1 implement preface option behind feature flag; phase 2 implement per-route defaults and Console toggle.
Ravi: I'll own phase 0 infra work and the canary tests. Marco can prototype preface in the adapter.
Marco: On it. I'll also add a minimal SDK shim that can reassemble preface+body for our internal web demo.
Elena: Thanks. Let's sync 20m tomorrow to finalize DSL wording.
Tess: +1.
InfraBot: Created task ARCH-1142: "fallback-stream-handoff-behaviors".
